subject: POC Credit Petition: temporary egress-free VPC sandbox for SOC2 evidence collection
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@medisage.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: egress-free VPC sandbox + credits for SOC2 evidence collection

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at MediSage wants to move forward with a Private/VPC POC to collect SOC2 evidence for our upcoming audit (Q3 window). Because the audit requires that certain datasets never leave our isolated environment during evidence collection, we need a short-lived, egress-disabled sandbox where we can run ingestion and logging to produce the artifacts the auditor will review.

Two asks:
- Temporary credits (sandbox subsidy) to cover the compute during the 30-day evidence collection run — we are a mid-market health SaaS and this is a gating item for procurement.
- Confirmation we can run in an egress-disabled VPC (no outbound internet) with access logs exported to our S3 under strict controls.

Target timeline: start week of July 6, evidence collection window July 7–31.

I attached a short list of the artifacts the auditor expects. Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood can authorize a short-term credit allotment and the isolated cluster?

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director of Security Programs
MediSage Health
attachments: SOC2_evidence_checklist.pdf

Hi Lena — appreciate the context and the clear artifact list. We can support an egress-disabled Private sandbox for a time-boxed POC and provide promotional credits to offset the compute.

Quick plan:
- I will loop in security and our Dedicated/Private ops team to validate the isolation requirements and add the temporary egress rule set.
- Proposed credit: a promotional allotment to cover the 30-day run (I’ll confirm the exact token estimate after ops sizes the cluster; ballpark is 1.5M–2M tokens).
- We will require a brief attestation (signed addendum) that the environment is time-limited and that MediSage accepts the temporary SLA modification for this isolated run.

Can you confirm the exact start date (you mentioned July 7) and whether auditors will need a narrow pen-test window while we run? I’ve attached a short intake form (MediSage_MA_plan.xlsx) to capture the scope.

I’ll follow up to Karthik and security for approval.

Thanks,

Questions for security/ops:
- Can we provision an isolated cluster with egress disabled but with secure log export to customer-controlled S3?

- Finance/sales: what’s acceptable promotional credit here to keep the deal moving (they are a mid-market health customer; high enterprise potential)?

—Karthik
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: egress-free VPC sandbox + credits for SOC2 evidence collection

Karthik / Steph — I reviewed the checklist and the ask. Security is comfortable with a conditional approval if the following controls are in place:

Required controls (must be agreed and verified before provisioning):
- Environment provisioned in our Private offering with egress ACLs explicitly set to deny all outbound traffic.
- Logs (audit, access, query) exported to the customer-owned S3 bucket (we will validate bucket policy and IAM role before enabling export).
- A one-week pen-test freeze: no external pen-tests during the evidence collection window unless pre-approved and scheduled with our ops team.
- Signed addendum: time-bound (30 days) with acceptance of temporary support limitations and explicit return-to-standard-config on completion.
- Minimal privileged user list from the customer (names/emails) for RBAC; we will enforce least privilege.

If MediSage signs the addendum and provides the S3 policy and privilege list, security will green-light a promotional credit up to 2,000,000 tokens and ops will stand up the cluster. I’ve attached the SOC2 evidence checklist and a network diagram template for their engineer to fill.

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_checklist.pdf; network-diagram.png

—Olga Petrov
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>

Subject: Approved: temporary egress-free sandbox + promotional credits (conditional) — MediSage Health

Hi Lena — good news. Security and ops have provisionally approved a time-boxed, egress-disabled Private sandbox and a promotional credit allocation to support your evidence collection window (conditional approvals below).

What we need to move forward (please send by EOD Jul 2):
- Completed network-diagram.png (customer edition) and S3 bucket policy for log export.
- List of privileged users who require access during the run (email addresses).
- Signed addendum (DocuSign): https://www.docusign.com/Envelope?e=abc123 (note: time-limited addendum, 30 days).

What we are authorizing now: up to 2,000,000 token promo credit applied to the Private sandbox for the July 7–31 evidence window. Cluster will be provisioned with egress ACLs set to deny outbound internet; export will be configured to your supplied S3 and validated by security.

Attachments: MediSage_MA_plan.xlsx (please populate), SOC2_evidence_checklist.pdf, network-diagram.png

Next steps: once we receive the items above we will provision the environment and confirm the start date. If any of the required items are missing, provisioning will be delayed.

Thanks — we’ll keep the provisioning timeline tight to meet your audit window.

Best,
